_comment: How long each simulated command takes, in seconds, and what it returns. Anything not listed takes default_duration. Per command you may also set: fail (an error message - the command fails), fail_times (how many times it fails before it succeeds; default 1 when fail is set), hang (true - it never returns until the instrument is stopped), response (values for the command's response fields). properties gives values for a server's properties. See docs/SIMULATED_LAB.md.
